title: Validity of previous-snapshot sources
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $\ell$ be a finite list of bit sources, and let $T,n,t,i$ be natural numbers. If $t\,\mathrm{cfgStride}(M,|\ell|,T)\le i$, then every source in the list encoding the previous snapshot at time $t$ is valid for input width $n$, configuration width $\mathrm{cfgWidth}(M)$, and instruction index $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
$\ell$ is a finite list of bit sources
